description: Dinner at 5 does not mean the oven at 5: for a big bird, the oven time lands hours earlier than most people picture. The USDA roast time for an unstuffed turkey at 325F: the chart band and the middle of the band a plan should use, plus the oven-in time when a dinner date and time are given. With state frozen, it gives the USDA from-frozen chart band instead (cooking from frozen is safe and takes at least 50 percent longer). Covers 8 to 24 lb. Ends with the 165F check rule.

dinner_date.description: Optional dinner date, YYYY-MM-DD. Default when a time is given: the next upcoming turkey day (Thanksgiving, or Dec 25 once Thanksgiving has passed).

dinner_time.description: Optional dinner time, 24-hour HH:MM. With a dinner time, the tool returns when the bird goes in the oven.

state.description: Whether the bird is thawed or still frozen. Default: thawed. Frozen uses the USDA from-frozen roast chart.

weight_lb.description: Turkey weight in pounds, 8 to 24. Example: 18

name: get_roast_time
title: How long to roast
